<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:8:4">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>אית לן פ׳ דמועדא</he> have we a special millstone for the festive week (dare we grind during the festive week)?

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:4:7">Y. Taan. I, 64ᶜ</cite> top <he>דלא הוה גביי אלא פִלְחִי וכ׳</he> I had with me only my own portion (luncheon); why should I have spoken to you (invited you to eat) with insincerity? <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12">Lev. R. s. 12</cite> (vers. in Ar.) <he>אם שתי פִּלְחֵיה חמר</he> when he drinks his regular portion of wine; <he>יתר מן פלחיה</he> more than his wonted quantity.
